evidence_rule: REAL requires typed evidence: commit_id, api_response, db_result, receipt, hash, log, or url with 2xx.
ops_extension: ops.reality_ledger accepts BLOCKED and failed states
session_start_protocol: Read public.reality_ledger WHERE status='BLOCKED' before executing RAM work in any session.
binding_rules: Every RAM package emits a reality_ledger row at prod promotion only.
PARTIAL rows are emitted at dev inspection submission.
BLOCKED rows are emitted when dev inspection finds violations.
No reality_ledger row may have status=PRETEND.
Every reality_ledger row references at least one ram_asset_evidence row.
